Variants.Content: Mercenaries are bound together by coin, plunder, ransom, and enforceable contracts rather than blood ties and feudal oaths. The Free Cities possess a mature sellsword tradition, where great companies such as the Golden Company, the Second Sons, and the Stormcrows can be hired for distant wars, while smaller bands of hired swords mingle among caravans, castles, and local feuds. Mercenaries are not inevitably faithless; they care above all whether an employer pays, supplies, and honors promises as agreed. To nobles, they can rapidly fill out an army's ranks, and can also become a new threat when finances collapse.
